Efficiency and comfort use 100 as the baseline. Twice the number means twice the effect.
Efficiency: SUP earned for the same steps. 200 earns twice as much as 100. The bar ends at the best new shoe of this grade.
Comfort: steps credited per unit of energy. The bar ends at the best new shoe of this grade. Points can raise it until it saves %1$d%% energy.
Durability: minutes you can run with rewards on this shoe. The bar ends at full. It goes down as you run, a little differently each run.
Stars (★ to ★★★) show how well this shoe rolled within its grade. The type is its best-rolled stat.
The SUP you actually get is confirmed after the run.
